results.title: The Future of New Technology and Artificial Intelligence in Mental Health: Prosp
results.reason: This paper focuses on AI and digital technologies in mental health care, which falls under the AI/tech category that is explicitly rejected for the PsyArXiv clinical psychology hub. While it discusses mental health applications, the primary focus is on technological implementation rather than clinical psychology practice, assessment, diagnosis, or interventions.

results.title: Understanding Refugee Parent-Child Discrepancies in Reporting Socio-Emotional We
results.reason: The study examines parent-adolescent discrepancies in reporting socio-emotional well-being among Syrian refugees, which is directly relevant to clinical psychology practice, assessment, and diagnosis in refugee mental health.
results.authors: Andrea De Bartolo; Yuying Huang; Hamza Qayumi; Kaja K. Jasińska

results.title: Cognitive Feelings from Healthy Experience to Psychopathology: An Integrative Re
results.reason: This integrative review examines cognitive feelings (feeling of knowing, familiarity, presence, reality, confidence, agency, body ownership) across multiple disciplines and their relevance to psychopathology, with direct implications for understanding symptoms in various psychiatric disorders.
results.authors: Keisuke Suzuki; Yuri Terasawa; Yoshiyuki Nishio; Yuichi Yamashita

results.title: Targeting Emotion Coping Beliefs in Young Adults: A Randomized Controlled Trial
results.reason: This paper evaluates a single-session online intervention targeting emotion coping beliefs in young adults, which has direct clinical relevance for improving access to mental health care. The study uses a randomized controlled trial design to test the efficacy of 'Project WAVE', a novel intervention targeting transdiagnostic emotion intolerance processes.
results.authors: Riley McDanal; Hein Kim; Pau Ortells-Faci; Nicholas R. Eaton; Jessica L. Schleider

results.title: It's Not a Bug, It's a Feature: Agentic and Relational Needs as Two Alliance Pat
results.reason: This paper focuses on AI mental health tools and therapeutic alliance concepts without direct clinical application for practicing therapists. It's primarily about technology interface and theoretical frameworks rather than clinical psychology practice, assessment, diagnosis, or interventions.
